summary: Say or sign the counting numbers in order, by ones, up to at least 20.
See how many are in a small group of up to 5 right away, without counting.
Count up to 10 objects one by one, know the last number says how many, and that each next number is one more.
Tell if one group of up to 5 has more, less or the same as another, and use order words up to 10.
Match a group of 0 to 5 to its written number, and with help write some numbers up to 10.
Add and take away up to 5 with fingers, objects or drawings, and solve small story problems.
Copy, continue and make simple repeating patterns, and fill in a missing part of a pattern.
Compare or order up to 5 things by height or weight, and measure with the same unit, like snap cubes.
Name shapes in any size or turn, count their sides, sort flat and solid shapes, and build shapes.
Use and follow words about position and direction, like up, down, in front of and behind.
